units.source_text: [\[5\]](#part1331.html#w5) 掌管地方诸国国政的行政机构为国司厅，

en.t: The administrative office that governed the provincial affairs of the various regions was the provincial governor's office,

units.source_text: 其长官称国守，次官称介，三等官称掾，四等官称目。

en.t: its chief official was called the provincial governor, the deputy was called the assistant, the third-ranking official was called the secretary, and the fourth-ranking official was called the inspector.
